// MDC2 is an experimental, lossless mathematical-dependency compressor.
// It discovers distant chunk relationships, XOR/subtract lag dependencies,
// and overlapping bit-pattern candidates with hierarchical grammar rules.
//
// Usage:
//
//	go run mdc.go roundtrip <file>    # compress, restore, and SHA-256 verify
//	go run mdc.go compress  <file>    # writes <file>.mdc
//	go run mdc.go decompress <file.mdc> [-out restored.bin]
//
// Go 1.23+, standard library only.
package main

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"compress/flate"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/binary"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"flag"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

const (
	magic             = "MDC3"
	modeRaw      byte = 0
	modeGrammar  byte = 1
	modeRelation byte = 2
	modeGraph    byte = 3
	modeDeflate  byte = 4
	modeHybrid   byte = 5
	opConcat     byte = 0
	opNot        byte = 1
	opXor        byte = 2
	defaultLimit      = 2 * 1024 * 1024 // deliberately conservative: grammar exploration operates on bits
)

type rule struct {
	op   byte
	a, b uint32
}
type pair struct{ a, b uint32 }
type stats struct{ seen, usable, last int }
type model struct {
	length uint64
	value  uint64
	packed bool
}
type settings struct {
	rules, minUses                      int
	limit                               int64
	force                               bool
	noGraph, noLag, noGrammar, noHybrid bool
}

type summary struct {
	original, archive  int
	rules, symbols     int
	grammarBytes       int
	notRules, xorRules int
	raw                bool
	method             string
	detail             string
	sha                string
	elapsed            time.Duration
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) < 3 {
		usage()
	}
	cmd := os.Args[1]
	fs := flag.NewFlagSet(cmd, flag.ExitOnError)
	out := fs.String("out", "", "output path")
	maxRules := fs.Int("rules", 96, "maximum learned grammar rules")
	minUses := fs.Int("min-uses", 4, "minimum nonoverlapping occurrences for a rule")
	limit := fs.Int64("limit", defaultLimit, "maximum input/output size in bytes (raise for bigger experiments)")
	force := fs.Bool("force", false, "permit compressed modes even if larger than raw (experimental)")
	noGraph := fs.Bool("no-graph", false, "disable dependency graph")
	noLag := fs.Bool("no-lag", false, "disable lag predictors")
	noGrammar := fs.Bool("no-grammar", false, "disable bit grammar")
	noHybrid := fs.Bool("no-hybrid", false, "disable unified relationship encoder")
	if err := fs.Parse(os.Args[2:]); err != nil {
		die(err)
	}
	if fs.NArg() != 1 {
		usage()
	}
	path := fs.Arg(0)
	if *maxRules < 0 || *maxRules > 4096 || *minUses < 2 || *limit < 0 || *limit > math.MaxInt32 {
		die(errors.New("invalid -rules, -min-uses, or -limit"))
	}
	cfg := settings{rules: *maxRules, minUses: *minUses, limit: *limit, force: *force, noGraph: *noGraph, noLag: *noLag, noGrammar: *noGrammar, noHybrid: *noHybrid}

	src, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		die(err)
	}
	start := time.Now()
	switch cmd {
	case "compress":
		if int64(len(src)) > cfg.limit {
			die(fmt.Errorf("input exceeds -limit (%d bytes)", cfg.limit))
		}
		arc, s, err := compress(src, cfg)
		if err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		target := *out
		if target == "" {
			target = path + ".mdc"
		}
		if err := save(target, arc, path); err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		s.elapsed = time.Since(start)
		show(s, target)
	case "decompress":
		restored, err := decompress(src, cfg.limit)
		if err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		target := *out
		if target == "" {
			target = strings.TrimSuffix(path, ".mdc") + ".restored"
		}
		if err := save(target, restored, path); err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		fmt.Printf("Restored %d bytes -> %s (SHA-256 verified, %s)\n", len(restored), target, time.Since(start).Round(time.Millisecond))
	case "roundtrip":
		if int64(len(src)) > cfg.limit {
			die(fmt.Errorf("input exceeds -limit (%d bytes)", cfg.limit))
		}
		arc, s, err := compress(src, cfg)
		if err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		restored, err := decompress(arc, cfg.limit)
		if err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		if !bytes.Equal(src, restored) {
			die(errors.New("round-trip mismatch"))
		}
		arcPath := path + ".mdc"
		restoredPath := path + ".restored"
		if *out != "" {
			arcPath = *out
			restoredPath = *out + ".restored"
		}
		if err := save(arcPath, arc, path); err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		if err := save(restoredPath, restored, path); err != nil {
			die(err)
		}
		s.elapsed = time.Since(start)
		show(s, arcPath)
		fmt.Printf("PASS: restored %d identical bytes -> %s\n", len(restored), restoredPath)
	default:
		usage()
	}
}

func usage() {
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Usage: go run mdc.go <compress|decompress|roundtrip> [flags] <file>")
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Flags: -out PATH  -rules 96  -min-uses 4  -limit 2097152  -no-graph -no-lag -no-grammar -no-hybrid")
	os.Exit(2)
}
func die(err error) { fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "Error:", err); os.Exit(1) }
func save(path string, b []byte, source string) error {
	a, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	s, err := filepath.Abs(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if a == s {
		return errors.New("refusing to overwrite input file")
	}
	return os.WriteFile(path, b, 0644)
}
func show(s summary, path string) {
	kind := s.method
	if kind == "" {
		kind = "raw fallback"
	}
	pct := 0.0
	if s.original > 0 {
		pct = 100 * (1 - float64(s.archive)/float64(s.original))
	}
	fmt.Printf("%d -> %d bytes (%.2f%% savings), %s, %s\n", s.original, s.archive, pct, kind, s.elapsed.Round(time.Millisecond))
	if s.grammarBytes > 0 {
		fmt.Printf("Grammar candidate: %d bytes; %d rules (%d NOT, %d XOR); %d remaining tokens\n", s.grammarBytes, s.rules, s.notRules, s.xorRules, s.symbols)
	}
	if s.detail != "" {
		fmt.Println("Detail:", s.detail)
	}
	fmt.Printf("SHA-256: %s\nSaved: %s\n", s.sha, path)
}

func putVar(w io.Writer, n uint64) error {
	var b [binary.MaxVarintLen64]byte
	k := binary.PutUvarint(b[:], n)
	_, err := w.Write(b[:k])
	return err
}
func readVar(r io.ByteReader) (uint64, error) { return binary.ReadUvarint(r) }
func varSize(n uint64) int {
	count := 1
	for n >= 128 {
		n >>= 7
		count++
	}
	return count
}

func compress(input []byte, cfg settings) ([]byte, summary, error) {
	digest := sha256.Sum256(input)
	s := summary{original: len(input), sha: hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])}

	// Baseline: store the source untouched if the model cannot earn its overhead.
	var raw bytes.Buffer
	raw.WriteString(magic)
	raw.WriteByte(modeRaw)
	if err := putVar(&raw, uint64(len(input))); err != nil {
		return nil, s, err
	}
	raw.Write(digest[:])
	raw.Write(input)
	best := raw.Bytes()
	s.raw = true
	s.method = "raw"
	if len(input) == 0 {
		s.archive = len(best)
		return best, s, nil
	}
	// Plain entropy coding is evaluated separately, to avoid crediting the
	// mathematical-dependency model for ordinary DEFLATE savings.
	plain, err := encodeDeflate(input, digest)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, s, err
	}
	if len(plain) < len(best) || cfg.force && s.raw {
		best = plain
		s.raw = false
		s.method = "deflate"
		s.detail = "ordinary DEFLATE (no dependency rules)"
	}
	if !cfg.noHybrid && len(input) >= 256 {
		arc, detail, err := bestHybrid(input, digest)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, s, err
		}
		if len(arc) > 0 && len(arc) < len(best) {
			best = arc
			s.raw = false
			s.method = "hybrid"
			s.detail = detail
		}
	}
	if !cfg.noGraph && len(input) >= 64 {
		arc, detail, err := bestGraph(input, digest)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, s, err
		}
		if len(arc) > 0 && len(arc) < len(best) {
			best = arc
			s.raw = false
			s.method = "graph"
			s.detail = detail
		}
	}
	if !cfg.noLag && len(input) >= 128 {
		arc, detail, err := bestLag(input, digest)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, s, err
		}
		if len(arc) > 0 && len(arc) < len(best) {
			best = arc
			s.raw = false
			s.method = "lag"
			s.detail = detail
		}
	}
	// Bit-level pair analysis is expensive on large high-entropy inputs.
	if cfg.rules == 0 || cfg.noGrammar || len(input) > 32*1024 {
		s.archive = len(best)
		return best, s, nil
	}

	// Expand source to individual 0/1 tokens. Most-significant bit first.
	tokens := make([]uint32, 0, len(input)*8)
	for _, b := range input {
		for bit := 7; bit >= 0; bit-- {
			tokens = append(tokens, uint32((b>>uint(bit))&1))
		}
	}
	tokens, rules := learnGrammar(tokens, cfg.rules, cfg.minUses)
	rewrite(rules)
	s.rules, s.symbols = len(rules), len(tokens)
	for _, r := range rules {
		if r.op == opNot {
			s.notRules++
		}
		if r.op == opXor {
			s.xorRules++
		}
	}
	var archive bytes.Buffer
	archive.WriteString(magic)
	archive.WriteByte(modeGrammar)
	if err := putVar(&archive, uint64(len(input))); err != nil {
		return nil, s, err
	}
	archive.Write(digest[:])
	if err := putVar(&archive, uint64(len(rules))); err != nil {
		return nil, s, err
	}
	for _, r := range rules {
		archive.WriteByte(r.op)
		if err := putVar(&archive, uint64(r.a)); err != nil {
			return nil, s, err
		}
		if r.op != opNot {
			if err := putVar(&archive, uint64(r.b)); err != nil {
				return nil, s, err
			}
		}
	}
	if err := putVar(&archive, uint64(len(tokens))); err != nil {
		return nil, s, err
	}
	fw, err := flate.NewWriter(&archive, flate.BestCompression)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, s, err
	}
	bw := bufio.NewWriterSize(fw, 64*1024)
	for _, t := range tokens {
		if err := putVar(bw, uint64(t)); err != nil {
			fw.Close()
			return nil, s, err
		}
	}
	if err := bw.Flush(); err != nil {
		fw.Close()
		return nil, s, err
	}
	if err := fw.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, s, err
	}
	s.grammarBytes = archive.Len()
	if archive.Len() < len(best) {
		best = archive.Bytes()
		s.raw = false
		s.method = "grammar"
		s.detail = "bit-level Re-Pair patterns with NOT/XOR rewrites"
	}
	s.archive = len(best)
	return best, s, nil
}

// learnGrammar constructs a Re-Pair-style grammar. We count overlapping pair
// candidates, but only replace nonoverlapping instances in the final stream.
func learnGrammar(tokens []uint32, maxRules, minUses int) ([]uint32, []rule) {
	rules := make([]rule, 0, maxRules)
	for len(rules) < maxRules && len(tokens) >= minUses*2 {
		counts := make(map[pair]stats, 32)
		for i := 0; i+1 < len(tokens); i++ {
			key := pair{tokens[i], tokens[i+1]}
			st, ok := counts[key]
			st.seen++
			if !ok || i > st.last+1 {
				st.usable++
				st.last = i
			}
			counts[key] = st
		}
		var best pair
		bestCount := 0
		for p, st := range counts {
			// Tie breaks are deterministic regardless of map iteration order.
			if st.usable > bestCount || (st.usable == bestCount && (p.a < best.a || p.a == best.a && p.b < best.b)) {
				best, bestCount = p, st.usable
			}
		}
		if bestCount < minUses {
			break
		}
		id := uint32(2 + len(rules))
		out := make([]uint32, 0, len(tokens)-bestCount)
		for i := 0; i < len(tokens); {
			if i+1 < len(tokens) && tokens[i] == best.a && tokens[i+1] == best.b {
				out = append(out, id)
				i += 2
			} else {
				out = append(out, tokens[i])
				i++
			}
		}
		rules = append(rules, rule{op: opConcat, a: best.a, b: best.b})
		tokens = out
	}
	return tokens, rules
}

func maskFor(n uint64) uint64 {
	if n == 64 {
		return ^uint64(0)
	}
	return (uint64(1) << n) - 1
}
func ruleModel(r rule, prev []model) model {
	a := prev[r.a]
	switch r.op {
	case opConcat:
		b := prev[r.b]
		total := a.length + b.length
		if total <= 64 && a.packed && b.packed {
			return model{total, (a.value << b.length) | b.value, true}
		}
		return model{length: total}
	case opNot:
		return model{a.length, (^a.value) & maskFor(a.length), true}
	case opXor:
		return model{a.length, a.value ^ prev[r.b].value, true}
	}
	panic("bad rule")
}

// For patterns up to 64 bits, choose mathematical encodings that need no more
// operand bytes than their concatenation definition. All references point back.
func rewrite(rules []rule) {
	m := make([]model, 2, 2+len(rules))
	m[0] = model{1, 0, true}
	m[1] = model{1, 1, true}
	for i, r := range rules {
		v := ruleModel(r, m)
		candidate := r
		cost := varSize(uint64(r.a)) + varSize(uint64(r.b))
		if v.packed && v.length >= 2 {
			for j := 2; j < len(m); j++ {
				if !m[j].packed || m[j].length != v.length {
					continue
				}
				if v.value == (m[j].value ^ maskFor(v.length)) {
					c := varSize(uint64(j))
					if c < cost {
						candidate = rule{op: opNot, a: uint32(j)}
						cost = c
					}
				}
			}
			if v.length >= 4 {
				for j := 2; j < len(m); j++ {
					if !m[j].packed || m[j].length != v.length {
						continue
					}
					for k := j + 1; k < len(m); k++ {
						if !m[k].packed || m[k].length != v.length {
							continue
						}
						if m[j].value^m[k].value != v.value {
							continue
						}
						c := varSize(uint64(j)) + varSize(uint64(k))
						// Allow cost-neutral XOR to expose dependencies.
						if c < cost || (c == cost && candidate.op == opConcat) {
							candidate = rule{op: opXor, a: uint32(j), b: uint32(k)}
							cost = c
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
		rules[i] = candidate
		// The revised definition reconstructs exactly the same bits.
		m = append(m, v)
	}
}

func decompress(archive []byte, limit int64) ([]byte, error) {
	if len(archive) < 5 || (string(archive[:4]) != magic && string(archive[:4]) != "MDC2" && string(archive[:4]) != "MDC1") {
		return nil, errors.New("not an MDC1/MDC2/MDC3 archive")
	}
	legacy := string(archive[:4]) == "MDC1"
	mode := archive[4]
	if legacy && mode > modeGrammar {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid legacy mode")
	}
	reader := bytes.NewReader(archive[5:])
	n, err := readVar(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if n > uint64(limit) || n > uint64(math.MaxInt/8) {
		return nil, errors.New("declared output exceeds -limit")
	}
	var expected [32]byte
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(reader, expected[:]); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var output []byte
	if mode == modeRaw {
		if uint64(reader.Len()) != n {
			return nil, errors.New("raw payload has wrong size")
		}
		output = make([]byte, int(n))
		_, err = io.ReadFull(reader, output)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else if mode == modeGrammar {
		nr, err := readVar(reader)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if nr > 4096 {
			return nil, errors.New("excessive rule count")
		}
		rules := make([]rule, 0, int(nr))
		models := []model{{1, 0, true}, {1, 1, true}}
		for i := uint64(0); i < nr; i++ {
			op, err := reader.ReadByte()
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			a, err := readVar(reader)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			var b uint64
			if op != opNot {
				b, err = readVar(reader)
				if err != nil {
					return nil, err
				}
			}
			if a >= uint64(len(models)) || (op != opNot && b >= uint64(len(models))) {
				return nil, errors.New("rule has forward/invalid reference")
			}
			if op > opXor {
				return nil, errors.New("unknown rule operation")
			}
			r := rule{op, uint32(a), uint32(b)}
			ma, mb := models[a], models[b]
			if op == opXor && (ma.length != mb.length || !ma.packed || !mb.packed) {
				return nil, errors.New("invalid XOR rule")
			}
			if op == opNot && !ma.packed {
				return nil, errors.New("invalid NOT rule")
			}
			if op == opConcat && (ma.length > n*8 || mb.length > n*8 || ma.length+mb.length > n*8) {
				return nil, errors.New("rule expands beyond output")
			}
			m := ruleModel(r, models)
			if m.length > n*8 {
				return nil, errors.New("rule exceeds declared output")
			}
			rules = append(rules, r)
			models = append(models, m)
		}
		nsym, err := readVar(reader)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if nsym > n*8 {
			return nil, errors.New("too many symbols")
		}
		output = make([]byte, int(n))
		fl := flate.NewReader(reader)
		defer fl.Close()
		br := bufio.NewReader(fl)
		var written uint64
		stack := make([]uint32, 0, 64)
		appendBits := func(v uint64, bits uint64) error {
			if written+bits > n*8 {
				return errors.New("expanded data exceeds output size")
			}
			for j := bits; j > 0; j-- {
				if v&(uint64(1)<<(j-1)) != 0 {
					output[written/8] |= 1 << (7 - (written % 8))
				}
				written++
			}
			return nil
		}
		for i := uint64(0); i < nsym; i++ {
			symbol, err := readVar(br)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, fmt.Errorf("malformed token %d: %w", i, err)
			}
			if symbol >= uint64(len(models)) {
				return nil, errors.New("unknown token")
			}
			stack = append(stack, uint32(symbol))
			for len(stack) > 0 {
				id := stack[len(stack)-1]
				stack = stack[:len(stack)-1]
				m := models[id]
				if m.packed {
					if err := appendBits(m.value, m.length); err != nil {
						return nil, err
					}
				} else {
					r := rules[id-2] // nonpacked nodes must be concatenations
					if r.op != opConcat {
						return nil, errors.New("invalid rule structure")
					}
					stack = append(stack, r.b, r.a)
				}
			}
		}
		if written != n*8 {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("reconstructed %d bits, expected %d", written, n*8)
		}
		// Reject extra decoded data (including trailing token bytes).
		_, err = br.ReadByte()
		if err != io.EOF {
			if err == nil {
				return nil, errors.New("extra data after final token")
			}
			return nil, err
		}
	} else if mode == modeHybrid {
		output, err = decodeHybrid(reader, n, limit)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else if mode == modeDeflate {
		output, err = decodeDeflate(reader, n)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else if mode == modeRelation {
		output, err = decodeLag(reader, n)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else if mode == modeGraph {
		output, err = decodeGraph(reader, n)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	} else {
		return nil, errors.New("unknown archive mode")
	}
	if sha256.Sum256(output) != expected {
		return nil, errors.New("SHA-256 mismatch: corrupted archive")
	}
	return output, nil
}
package main

// Graph and lag predictors exploit exact mathematical relationships among
// high-entropy byte blocks. Both are invertible, deterministic transforms.

import (
	"bufio"
	"bytes"
	"compress/flate"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"math"
	"sort"
)

const (
	blockRaw byte = iota
	blockCopy
	blockXorConstant
	blockXorPattern
	blockXorPair
	blockXorResidual
)

type graphOp struct {
	kind    byte
	a, b    int
	mask    []byte
	payload []byte
}
type fingerprint struct {
	sig  uint64
	norm uint64
}

func blockSig(s []byte) uint64 {
	var sig uint64
	for i := 0; i < 8 && i < len(s); i++ {
		sig |= uint64(s[i]) << (8 * i)
	}
	return sig
}
func normHash(s []byte) uint64 {
	// FNV64 over the prefix, invariant under a constant-byte XOR mask.
	var h uint64 = 14695981039346656037
	for i := 1; i < len(s) && i < 33; i++ {
		h ^= uint64(s[i] ^ s[0])
		h *= 1099511628211
	}
	return h
}
func isExact(a, b []byte) bool { return bytes.Equal(a, b) }
func xorConstant(a, b []byte) (byte, bool) {
	if len(a) != len(b) || len(a) == 0 {
		return 0, false
	}
	mask := a[0] ^ b[0]
	for i := 1; i < len(a); i++ {
		if a[i]^b[i] != mask {
			return 0, false
		}
	}
	return mask, true
}
func xorPattern(a, b []byte) ([]byte, bool) {
	if len(a) != len(b) || len(a) < 4 {
		return nil, false
	}
	for period := 2; period <= 16 && period < len(a)/2; period++ {
		// Period 1 is already considered by xorConstant.
		p := make([]byte, period)
		for k := 0; k < period; k++ {
			p[k] = a[k] ^ b[k]
		}
		matches := true
		for k := period; k < len(a); k++ {
			if a[k]^b[k] != p[k%period] {
				matches = false
				break
			}
		}
		if matches {
			return p, true
		}
	}
	return nil, false
}
func xorPairEqual(a, b, c []byte) bool {
	if len(a) != len(b) || len(a) != len(c) {
		return false
	}
	for k := range c {
		if a[k]^b[k] != c[k] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func diffScore(a, b []byte) int {
	// Rough savings proxy: how concentrated is the bytewise XOR residual?
	// A high concentration gives the entropy coder a simple target.
	var hist [256]int
	for i := range a {
		hist[a[i]^b[i]]++
	}
	max := 0
	for _, n := range hist {
		if n > max {
			max = n
		}
	}
	return max
}
func selectGraphOps(src []byte, width int) ([]graphOp, string) {
	n := (len(src) + width - 1) / width
	chunks := make([][]byte, n)
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		end := (i + 1) * width
		if end > len(src) {
			end = len(src)
		}
		chunks[i] = src[i*width : end]
	}
	ops := make([]graphOp, 0, n)
	sigs := make(map[uint64][]int, n)
	norms := make(map[uint64][]int, n)
	counts := make(map[byte]int)
	for i, b := range chunks {
		selected := graphOp{kind: blockRaw, payload: b}
		// Exact references, complementary masks, and short periodic XOR masks.
		// Normalized indexes offer O(1) candidate retrieval for constant masks.
		for j := len(norms[normHash(b)]) - 1; j >= 0; j-- {
			k := norms[normHash(b)][j]
			if len(chunks[k]) != len(b) {
				continue
			}
			m, ok := xorConstant(b, chunks[k])
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			if m == 0 {
				selected = graphOp{kind: blockCopy, a: k}
			} else {
				selected = graphOp{kind: blockXorConstant, a: k, mask: []byte{m}}
			}
			break
		}
		// XOR relations C = A XOR B, using the XOR-linear first-eight-byte key.
		if selected.kind == blockRaw && len(b) >= 8 {
			for j := 0; j < i; j++ {
				want := blockSig(b) ^ blockSig(chunks[j])
				cand := sigs[want]
				found := false
				for _, k := range cand {
					if k >= j || len(chunks[k]) != len(b) || len(chunks[j]) != len(b) {
						continue
					}
					if xorPairEqual(chunks[j], chunks[k], b) {
						selected = graphOp{kind: blockXorPair, a: j, b: k}
						found = true
						break
					}
				}
				if found {
					break
				}
			}
		}
		if selected.kind == blockRaw {
			// Compare with earlier blocks for near-matches, masks, or residuals.
			// Limit the lookback for bounded time on large files.
			bestScore := 0
			bestRef := -1
			from := i - 128
			if from < 0 {
				from = 0
			}
			for j := i - 1; j >= from; j-- {
				if len(chunks[j]) != len(b) {
					continue
				}
				if p, ok := xorPattern(b, chunks[j]); ok {
					selected = graphOp{kind: blockXorPattern, a: j, mask: p}
					break
				}
				score := diffScore(b, chunks[j])
				if score > bestScore {
					bestScore = score
					bestRef = j
				}
			}
			if selected.kind == blockRaw && bestRef >= 0 && bestScore*100 >= len(b)*35 {
				// These heuristics only select the predicted residual. The final
				// actual compressed archive must beat the raw-file fallback.
				residual := make([]byte, len(b))
				for j := range b {
					residual[j] = b[j] ^ chunks[bestRef][j]
				}
				selected = graphOp{kind: blockXorResidual, a: bestRef, payload: residual}
			}
		}
		ops = append(ops, selected)
		counts[selected.kind]++
		sigs[blockSig(b)] = append(sigs[blockSig(b)], i)
		norms[normHash(b)] = append(norms[normHash(b)], i)
	}
	return ops, fmt.Sprintf("chunk=%d; raw=%d, equal=%d, XOR-constant=%d, XOR-periodic=%d, XOR-pair=%d, XOR-residual=%d", width, counts[blockRaw], counts[blockCopy], counts[blockXorConstant], counts[blockXorPattern], counts[blockXorPair], counts[blockXorResidual])
}
func encodeGraph(src []byte, digest [32]byte, width int) ([]byte, string, error) {
	ops, detail := selectGraphOps(src, width)
	var meaningful bool
	for _, op := range ops {
		if op.kind != blockRaw {
			meaningful = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !meaningful {
		return nil, "", nil
	}
	var out bytes.Buffer
	out.WriteString(magic)
	out.WriteByte(modeGraph)
	putVar(&out, uint64(len(src)))
	out.Write(digest[:])
	putVar(&out, uint64(width))
	fw, err := flate.NewWriter(&out, flate.BestCompression)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	bw := bufio.NewWriterSize(fw, 64*1024)
	for _, op := range ops {
		if err := bw.WriteByte(op.kind); err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		switch op.kind {
		case blockCopy, blockXorConstant, blockXorPattern, blockXorResidual:
			if err := putVar(bw, uint64(op.a)); err != nil {
				return nil, "", err
			}
		case blockXorPair:
			if err := putVar(bw, uint64(op.a)); err != nil {
				return nil, "", err
			}
			if err := putVar(bw, uint64(op.b)); err != nil {
				return nil, "", err
			}
		}
		switch op.kind {
		case blockXorConstant:
			if err := bw.WriteByte(op.mask[0]); err != nil {
				return nil, "", err
			}
		case blockXorPattern:
			if err := bw.WriteByte(byte(len(op.mask))); err != nil {
				return nil, "", err
			}
			if _, err := bw.Write(op.mask); err != nil {
				return nil, "", err
			}
		case blockRaw, blockXorResidual:
			if _, err := bw.Write(op.payload); err != nil {
				return nil, "", err
			}
		}
	}
	if err := bw.Flush(); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	if err := fw.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	return out.Bytes(), detail, nil
}
func bestGraph(src []byte, digest [32]byte) ([]byte, string, error) {
	widths := []int{128, 192, 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096, 8192}
	var best []byte
	detail := ""
	for _, w := range widths {
		if w > len(src) || (len(src)+w-1)/w > 512 {
			continue
		}
		arc, d, err := encodeGraph(src, digest, w)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		if len(arc) > 0 && (best == nil || len(arc) < len(best)) {
			best, detail = arc, d
		}
	}
	return best, detail, nil
}
func decodeGraph(reader *bytes.Reader, n uint64) ([]byte, error) {
	width64, err := readVar(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if width64 == 0 || width64 > n+1 || width64 > math.MaxInt32 {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid graph width")
	}
	width := int(width64)
	chunkCount := (int(n) + width - 1) / width
	if chunkCount > 1000000 {
		return nil, errors.New("excessive graph chunks")
	}
	out := make([]byte, int(n))
	fl := flate.NewReader(reader)
	defer fl.Close()
	br := bufio.NewReader(fl)
	for i := 0; i < chunkCount; i++ {
		offset := i * width
		count := width
		if offset+count > len(out) {
			count = len(out) - offset
		}
		dest := out[offset : offset+count]
		kind, err := br.ReadByte()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		var ref1, ref2 uint64
		if kind == blockCopy || kind == blockXorConstant || kind == blockXorPattern || kind == blockXorResidual || kind == blockXorPair {
			ref1, err = readVar(br)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if ref1 >= uint64(i) {
				return nil, errors.New("forward graph reference")
			}
		}
		if kind == blockXorPair {
			ref2, err = readVar(br)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if ref2 >= uint64(i) {
				return nil, errors.New("forward XOR reference")
			}
		}
		getRef := func(r uint64) ([]byte, error) {
			st := int(r) * width
			if st+count > offset {
				return nil, errors.New("graph reference crosses boundary")
			}
			return out[st : st+count], nil
		}
		switch kind {
		case blockRaw:
			if _, err = io.ReadFull(br, dest); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		case blockCopy, blockXorConstant, blockXorPattern, blockXorResidual:
			previous, e := getRef(ref1)
			if e != nil {
				return nil, e
			}
			switch kind {
			case blockCopy:
				copy(dest, previous)
			case blockXorConstant:
				mask, e := br.ReadByte()
				if e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				for k := range dest {
					dest[k] = previous[k] ^ mask
				}
			case blockXorPattern:
				period, e := br.ReadByte()
				if e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				if period < 2 || period > 16 {
					return nil, errors.New("bad graph mask period")
				}
				mask := make([]byte, int(period))
				if _, e = io.ReadFull(br, mask); e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				for k := range dest {
					dest[k] = previous[k] ^ mask[k%len(mask)]
				}
			case blockXorResidual:
				if _, e = io.ReadFull(br, dest); e != nil {
					return nil, e
				}
				for k := range dest {
					dest[k] ^= previous[k]
				}
			}
		case blockXorPair:
			a, e := getRef(ref1)
			if e != nil {
				return nil, e
			}
			b, e := getRef(ref2)
			if e != nil {
				return nil, e
			}
			for k := range dest {
				dest[k] = a[k] ^ b[k]
			}
		default:
			return nil, errors.New("unknown graph operation")
		}
	}
	_, err = br.ReadByte()
	if err != io.EOF {
		if err == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("extra graph bytes")
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return out, nil
}

// XOR and subtraction-lag predictors are fully reversible: the decoder
// rebuilds each byte from a previous byte and the stored residual.
const (
	lagXOR byte = iota
	lagSubtract
)

type lagCandidate struct {
	lag   int
	op    byte
	score float64
}

func candidateLags(src []byte) []int {
	base := []int{1, 2, 3, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 192, 256, 384, 512, 768, 1024, 1536, 2048, 3072, 4096, 6144, 8192, 12288, 16384}
	counts := make(map[int]int)
	// Adjacent-byte-XOR windows are invariant to a uniform XOR mask.
	// Repeating them across the input yields candidate nonlocal boundaries.
	var last = make(map[uint64]int)
	for i := 0; i+9 <= len(src); i += 4 {
		var sig uint64
		for j := 0; j < 8; j++ {
			sig |= uint64(src[i+j]^src[i+j+1]) << (8 * j)
		}
		if prev, ok := last[sig]; ok {
			lag := i - prev
			if lag >= 16 && lag <= 32768 {
				counts[lag]++
			}
		}
		last[sig] = i
	}
	type kv struct{ lag, count int }
	rank := make([]kv, 0, len(counts))
	for lag, count := range counts {
		rank = append(rank, kv{lag, count})
	}
	sort.Slice(rank, func(i, j int) bool {
		if rank[i].count != rank[j].count {
			return rank[i].count > rank[j].count
		}
		return rank[i].lag < rank[j].lag
	})
	for i := 0; i < len(rank) && i < 10; i++ {
		base = append(base, rank[i].lag)
	}
	seen := make(map[int]bool)
	out := make([]int, 0, len(base))
	for _, n := range base {
		if n > 0 && n < len(src)/2 && !seen[n] {
			seen[n] = true
			out = append(out, n)
		}
	}
	sort.Ints(out)
	return out
}
func lagResidual(src []byte, lag int, op byte) ([]byte, float64) {
	res := make([]byte, len(src))
	var hist [256]int
	for i, b := range src {
		var r byte
		if i < lag {
			r = b
		} else if op == lagXOR {
			r = b ^ src[i-lag]
		} else {
			r = b - src[i-lag]
		}
		res[i] = r
		hist[r]++
	}
	entropy := 0.0
	for _, h := range hist {
		if h > 0 {
			p := float64(h) / float64(len(src))
			entropy -= p * math.Log2(p)
		}
	}
	// Initial lag bytes are untransformed; penalize very large lags.
	return res, entropy * float64(len(src)) / 8
}
func encodeLag(src []byte, digest [32]byte, lag int, op byte, payload []byte) ([]byte, error) {
	var out bytes.Buffer
	out.WriteString(magic)
	out.WriteByte(modeRelation)
	putVar(&out, uint64(len(src)))
	out.Write(digest[:])
	out.WriteByte(op)
	putVar(&out, uint64(lag))
	fw, err := flate.NewWriter(&out, flate.BestCompression)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err = fw.Write(payload); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err = fw.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return out.Bytes(), nil
}
func bestLag(src []byte, digest [32]byte) ([]byte, string, error) {
	var candidates []lagCandidate
	for _, lag := range candidateLags(src) {
		for op := byte(0); op < 2; op++ {
			_, score := lagResidual(src, lag, op)
			candidates = append(candidates, lagCandidate{lag, op, score})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(candidates, func(i, j int) bool {
		if candidates[i].score != candidates[j].score {
			return candidates[i].score < candidates[j].score
		}
		if candidates[i].lag != candidates[j].lag {
			return candidates[i].lag < candidates[j].lag
		}
		return candidates[i].op < candidates[j].op
	})
	var best []byte
	description := ""
	// Entropy estimate chooses candidates, but only the actual encoded archive
	// decides whether a transform was beneficial.
	for i := 0; i < len(candidates) && i < 10; i++ {
		c := candidates[i]
		residual, _ := lagResidual(src, c.lag, c.op)
		arc, err := encodeLag(src, digest, c.lag, c.op, residual)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		if len(arc) > 0 && (best == nil || len(arc) < len(best)) {
			best = arc
			name := "XOR"
			if c.op == lagSubtract {
				name = "subtract"
			}
			description = fmt.Sprintf("%s residual with backward lag %d bytes", name, c.lag)
		}
	}
	return best, description, nil
}
func decodeLag(reader *bytes.Reader, n uint64) ([]byte, error) {
	op, err := reader.ReadByte()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if op > lagSubtract {
		return nil, errors.New("unknown lag operation")
	}
	lag64, err := readVar(reader)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if lag64 == 0 || lag64 >= n {
		return nil, errors.New("invalid lag")
	}
	lag := int(lag64)
	fl := flate.NewReader(reader)
	defer fl.Close()
	out := make([]byte, int(n))
	if _, err = io.ReadFull(fl, out); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra [1]byte
	extraN, e := fl.Read(extra[:])
	if extraN != 0 || e != io.EOF {
		if e == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("extra lag data")
		}
		return nil, e
	}
	for i := lag; i < len(out); i++ {
		if op == lagXOR {
			out[i] ^= out[i-lag]
		} else {
			out[i] += out[i-lag]
		}
	}
	return out, nil
}

// Used by test suites to verify that relation matching uses true XOR,
// not a hash collision or an accidental approximate equality.

// Ordinary entropy coding baseline, with SHA-256 coverage supplied by header.
func encodeDeflate(src []byte, digest [32]byte) ([]byte, error) {
	var out bytes.Buffer
	out.WriteString(magic)
	out.WriteByte(modeDeflate)
	if err := putVar(&out, uint64(len(src))); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	out.Write(digest[:])
	fw, err := flate.NewWriter(&out, flate.BestCompression)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err = fw.Write(src); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err = fw.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return out.Bytes(), nil
}
func decodeDeflate(r *bytes.Reader, n uint64) ([]byte, error) {
	fr := flate.NewReader(r)
	defer fr.Close()
	out := make([]byte, int(n))
	if _, err := io.ReadFull(fr, out); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var extra [1]byte
	more, err := fr.Read(extra[:])
	if more != 0 || err != io.EOF {
		if err == nil {
			return nil, errors.New("extra DEFLATE bytes")
		}
		return nil, err
	}
	return out, nil
}
